card.text: Inner-belt asteroid that names the Hungaria group.

sources.label: Galiazzo et al. (2013), Fugitives from the Hungaria region
sources.quote: Named after (434) Hungaria these asteroids are relatively small

introduction.text: M. Wolf found Hungaria at Heidelberg in 1898. It may be where the aubrite meteorites come from.

sources.label: JPL Small-Body Database
sources.quote: 434 Hungaria (A898 RB); Discovered 1898-Sep-11 by Wolf, M. at Heidelberg; orbit class: Inner Main-belt Asteroid

sources.label: Ćuk et al. (2014), Hungaria asteroid family as the source of aubrite meteorites
sources.quote: We find that, after Vesta, (434) Hungaria is the best candidate for an asteroidal source of an achondrite group.

shape.title: Light-curve shape model
shape.summary: Shape from brightness changes as it spins, sized by an infrared survey. The spin angle shown is arbitrary.

elevation.title: Shape-derived elevations
elevation.summary: Height above or below a 4.467 km sphere, sharing the size uncertainty. Colors mix the overall shape with local relief.
